split: sha256(normalized finish family) modulo 5: 0,1 holdout; 2,3,4 training
primary: candidate participates in positive net DMarket route with a fixed partner using fully covered bids at both selling legs
secondary: same with any of nine existing sale assumptions
primary_fee_hypothesis: CSGO Trader summary is Steam buyer gross; test-only assumption
sensitivity_fee_hypothesis: CSGO Trader summary is Steam seller net; reconstruct buyer gross for return scoring
selection: outward,outward,return,return,random exploration, deduplicated; below-threshold/unknown candidates remain in exploration
control: uniform shuffle of same eligible cohort, same total candidate HTTP budget; common partner cost charged equally
eligibility: pre-freeze DMarket ask or Steam summary price in [10,1000] cents; no future price used for selection
limitations: Historical cohort was not randomly collected and includes observations from the subsequently reverted Task 4 reader.
Fixed partner test does not search the whole market.
No claims about actual realized profits, future sellability or holding-period price movement.
No production fee qualification or threshold will be changed by this test.
